annotation.title_clean: 发改价格〔2026〕1476号（养老服务收费政策通知）
annotation.title_en: NDRC Price [2026] No. 1476 (Notice on Elderly Care Service Fee Policy)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家发展和改革委员会 (National Development and Reform Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Excerpt of a Chinese NDRC pricing notice (dated 12 October 2026) on elderly care service fees. It sets market-regulated pricing for small community care facilities and home-visit services, requires price monitoring, and requires fee policies to be reviewed at least every three years. It does not concern AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Community elderly care facilities with fewer than 10 full-care beds generally use market-regulated prices; government-guided prices are possible if the provincial government approves
Home-visit service fees are market-regulated, and authorities may publish reference ranges for them
Local development and reform departments must improve price monitoring for elderly care services
Fee policies must be evaluated regularly, generally at least every 3 years, through self-assessment or third-party assessment
Provinces must report the results of fee-policy evaluations to the State Council's development and reform and sector departments
